name: Latched key-operated switch
summary: A latched key-operated switch retains its commanded position according to the selected mechanism.
description: A latched key-operated switch retains its commanded position according to the selected mechanism. The drawing should specify how the latched position is released and where the key is removable.
readingNotes: Separate the mechanical retention from any electrical seal-in circuit.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Mechanically latched operation is different from a relay holding circuit.
